artworks.title: GAZINI
artworks.description: This haute couture evening gown is a masterclass in structure, transparency, and regal opulence, seamlessly blending a sultry silhouette with architectural majesty.

artworks.title: RUBY
artworks.description: embodies pure elegance, drama, and timeless glamour. The piece features a stunning model showcasing a deep, plunging V-neck ballgown in a captivating shade of rich ruby red. The bodice is beautifully ruched, flowing seamlessly into a dramatic, voluminous skirt that finishes with a spectacular, shimmering gradient of crimson glitter at the hem. With her hair swept up into an elegant, effortless updo and a bold red lip to match the gown, "Ruby" is the ultimate expression of red-carpet sophistication and high-fashion allure.

artworks.title: SARIBELLA
artworks.description: Saribella is a breathtaking, sultry fusion of traditional allure and ultra-modern high fashion. Drenched in a deep, commanding shade of crimson red, this evening gown is designed for a confident woman

artworks.title: PINTA
artworks.description: "Pinta" is a striking, high-fashion evening gown illustration that balances dramatic volume with a sleek, structured silhouette. The design exudes modern glamour, relying heavily on texture, contrast, and shimmering details to create a captivating visual impact.
